slug: 2024-08-26 DRC's largest data centre opens (Raxio DRC1, Kinshasa)

facts.fact: Communications Africa reports Raxio Group launched Raxio DRC1 in Kinshasa, described as the DRC's largest data centre (US$30m investment).
Communications Africa states Raxio DRC1 in Kinshasa has Tier III accreditation from the Uptime Institute.
Communications Africa states two Tier-III data centres opened in Kinshasa in August 2024: Raxio DRC1 and OADC Texaf Digital.
